20:58.en: 「I'll knock you out of the sky!」
alternatives: I'll smash you into the ground!

20:185.en: 「I won't let you do as you please!」
alternatives: I won't let you have your way!
I'll be the one to down Gundam!
Even if my foe is a Gundam!

20:360.en: 「I'll take down the flashy one first!」
alternatives: The flashy one goes down first!

20:387.en: 「A private company has no place here!」
alternatives: A civilian firm has no place here!

20:418.en: 「No matter how thick your armor is!」

alternatives: Not all can be pierced!\nYou'll see!

20:623.en: 「In the end, it's just a big machine!」
alternatives: It's nothing but a big machine!
It's only big! I'll flank it!

20:782.en: 「What can that tiny machine even do?!」
alternatives: What can such a tiny machine do?!

20:898.en: 「You won't have your way with Earth!」

20:1196.en: 「At this rate, I'm a sitting duck!」
alternatives: I'm a sitting duck like this!
I'll have to wait for my chance...!

20:1312.en: 「I've got no choice but to pull back!」
alternatives: I'll have to pull back for now!

20:1341.en: 「Do I have to let them go?!」
alternatives: Must I let it get away?!

20:1366.en: 「If I don't pull back, I'm done for!」
alternatives: I'll be done for if I don't retreat!
Where the hell are you aiming!
What the hell are you aiming at!

20:1615.en: 「I can do this! I can match Gundam!」

20:1695.en: 「If it misses, any attack is useless!」
alternatives: No attack matters if it can't hit!

20:1738.en: 「I'll throw you off with my speed!」
alternatives: I'll use my speed to throw you off!
Just as I thought - all show!
As if that could hurt me!
Ha! Is that all you've got?!
Damn! I let my guard down!

20:2083.en: 「A scratch or two won't stop me!」
alternatives: One or two wounds won't stop me!

20:2120.en: 「That'll never be enough to stop us!」
alternatives: That won't be enough to stop us!

20:2322.en: 「Damn! They aim right where it hurts!」
alternatives: Damn! They aim where it hurts!
Ngh! I can't track their movement!

20:2450.en: 「This is bad! My sensors are down!」

20:2518.en: 「We can fight Gundam on equal terms!」

20:2621.en: 「I won't let it end like this!」

20:2652.en: 「Guh! I'll hold out at any cost!」
alternatives: Ngh! I'll keep it going at any cost!
I won't just turn tail and run!!

20:2776.en: 「As long as it moves, I'll manage!!」
alternatives: If the machine moves, I'll manage!!

20:2904.en: 「I-Is this as far as I go?!」
